title: Extreme surplus, battery full, 20% cap
description: Very high PV (18.5 MW) with the battery already full at 90% SOC and curtailment capped at 20%. Every candidate is simulated and fails; the required curtailment is reported against the cap.
parameter_rationale: pv_multiplier 88: above all_levers_infeasible_mult_no_battery (80); battery full = cannot charge
